usage: speechloom [-h] [--version] [--config CONFIG]
                  {doctor,transcribe,inspect} ...

Transcribe local audio and video with NeMo-Speech.cpp.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,transcribe,inspect}
    doctor              Validate runtime, models, backend, and output
    transcribe          Transcribe one or more media inputs
    inspect             Inspect a job directory or manifest

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --config CONFIG       INI configuration file
